title.en: the corner store at the cosmopolitan.

line.en: the new restaurant on the cosmopolitan's third floor, open since 9 november. dinner friday and saturday from 5 pm, until late.
line.de: das neue restaurant im dritten stock des cosmopolitan, seit 9. november offen. abendessen freitag und samstag ab 17 uhr, bis spät.
line.tr: cosmopolitan'ın üçüncü katındaki yeni restoran, 9 kasım'dan beri açık. cuma ve cumartesi akşam yemeği 17:00'den itibaren, geç saatlere kadar.

sparks.why: The Corner Store opened at The Cosmopolitan on 9 Nov 2026, Fri and Sat dinner from 5 pm until late (Mann Report, Haute Living, LA Mag debut coverage).
